w;s úfYIThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

I hereby give notice for information of General Public that as per No. E-15 of Hon. General Meeting held on 11.09.2025, roads and paths included in this Schedule should be declared as roads and paths belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha in terms of task assigned to Pradeshiya Sabhas in Sabaragamuwa Province by the series of orders with regard to publishing notices indicating register and caused to be prepared plans for roads and paths maintained by Sabaragamuwa Province having been declared in Extraordinaiy Gazette Notiﬁ cation No. 2316/20 and dated 24th of January ,2023 by Hon. Governor in Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council read as Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987

If opinion of party claiming to a land that any road or a path included in the said schedule is inchlusive in any partition of land, I hereby notify that legal actions should be taken to institute an action in the competent court before expiration of a period of three months from this Notice to prove his right for the said land .

Further, I notify that every road and path included in the said schedule which hasn 't been instituted an legal action before expiration of the said period of three months should be deemed to be a road or a path belonged to Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha.
W.H.M.P. Dൺඋඌඁൺඇൺ Vൺංൽඒൺඋൺඍඁඇൺ, Chairman, Ruwanwella Praseshiya Sabha.At Ruwanwella Pradeshiya Sabha, Ruwanwella,13th of October 2025.
